evidence: GaC1 was formed by the reaction between metallic Ga and HCI at 780°C, and fed intermittently by a suction pump, and AsH3 was introduced alternately from a separate tube using air-operated run-and-vent valves. One ALE cycle consisted of four stages: GaCI supply (step 1), H2 purge (step 2), AsH3 supply (step 3) and H2 purge (step 4).
